Pricing

Simple pricing, built for where you are.

Always free for students and clients. Professionals can start free too, with paid tiers to unlock more.

Always free

Vono Student Account

Students
$0
Free, no credit card required
  • Pace

    A real-time projection of your graduation date, calculated from the hours and services you log, your absences, holidays, and your actual schedule.

  • Refresher

    Step-by-step guided walkthroughs for haircut, chemical, and safety techniques, to practice or brush up on anytime.

  • Consult

    A guided set of questions to practice working through before recommending a product or service to a client.

  • Ledger

    Self-rate your own confidence, 1 to 10, on individual techniques, building a shareable skill portfolio you can send to an instructor or a future employer.

  • Jobs Board

    Browse postings from shops that are hiring, or post that you're looking, with your expected graduation date and a link to your portfolio.

Vono Basic

Independent professionals
$0
Free, no credit card required
  • Booking

    Set up your services, hours, VIP hours, and date overrides, and manage your calendar. Add appointments yourself for a walk-in, a phone booking, or a client whose phone's dead, including starting a brand-new client's Vono Passport on the spot if it's their first visit.

  • Client lookup & photo history

    Scan or look up a client's Vono Passport to see their past visit photos and notes, log a note about today's visit, and add new before/after photos once they've consented.

  • Consult

    The same guided consultation tool students get.

  • Refresher

    The same step-by-step technique walkthroughs students get.

  • Jobs Board

    Browse postings, or post that you're hiring.

Not included on Basic — Pro or Studio required
  • Clients booking you online. No QR code, and you won't appear on Find a Pro.
  • Messaging clients (the "Notify client" option), in either direction.
  • Push notifications.
  • Business tools: Loyalty, Earnings, Walk-ins, My Clients, Inventory, Shop, and Rent & Commission.
  • Payment links (Venmo, Cash App, Zelle, Apple Pay).
Get started free
Most popular

Vono Pro

Independent professionals
$20/month
7-day free trial
Everything in Basic, plus:
  • Clients book you online

    Your booking link and QR code go live, and you're searchable on Find a Pro, both of which are completely inert on Basic.

  • Message clients directly

    In either direction, from the "Notify client" option on any appointment.

  • Automatic client notifications

    Each one toggleable on its own: you get pinged when a client books or cancels, clients get a gentle nudge to rebook after about 90 days of no visits, and clients get a reminder before their upcoming appointment.

  • Payment links

    On your booking page: Venmo, Cash App, Zelle, Apple Pay.

Business tools
  • Loyalty

    Reward tiers based on completed appointments, resets once a client hits your top tier and you mark it redeemed.

  • Earnings

    Year-to-date and month-by-month totals pulled from completed appointments and logged walk-ins, with CSV download.

  • Walk-ins

    Log clients you took payment from outside the app.

  • My Clients

    A searchable list of everyone you've served through Consult, plus mass messaging (shop announcements or promotions) to clients who've opted in.

  • Inventory

    Track product stock on hand.

  • Rent & Commission (personal)

    Your own record of what you pay out for your chair, booth, or commission, whether that's to a Studio owner, an independent landlord, or a shop that's never used Vono.

Not included on Vono Pro — Studio required
  • Shop (creating a shop, inviting a team, and tracking what your team owes you).
Start free trial

Vono Studio

Shops and multi-pro teams
$30/month
7-day free trial
Everything in Pro, plus running a multi-person shop:
  • Create your own shop

    Set up a shop profile (name, address, city, state, phone) and get a shop code other pros can use to join you.

  • Build your team

    Invite other professionals by their personal booking code, and see pending and accepted invites.

  • Team roster

    See your full team at a glance.

  • Track what your team owes you

    Set up flat rent or commission per team member, on a weekly, biweekly, or monthly schedule starting from a date you choose. Log each payment (Studio auto-calculates your cut on commission), see a running history, view year-by-year totals, and download or print the records.

  • Your team's clients stay private

    Anyone who joins your shop keeps their own clients, bookings, and consults private — you can't see them, only your own.

  • Flexibility to leave

    A staff member can leave a shop at any time.

Start free trial
This team-wide tracker is separate from the personal Rent & Commission tool under the Business tab, which is for a pro paying rent or commission to someone else, not for tracking a team.
